recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No further core source change is indicated unless OO later decides to make the guidance a formal invariant or add examples beyond this clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-15561 asked for guidance on when a Task may stand alone versus when Task.focus should reference the thing being acted on. It is Applied/Persuasive with an approved resolution to add: "If a Task is seeking to instantiate or modify an entity represented by a FHIR resource, the resource SHOULD be pointed to by the Task.focus."
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 15f0305d04ad1b63634ef0462c0a443d1eb02842 through PR HL7/fhir#3532, adding guidance to source/task/task-introduction.xml. That commit used the earlier proposed wording, saying instantiate or modify "something" SHALL be pointed to Task.focus, rather than the final voted SHOULD/resource wording.
additional_context: The 2025-05-02 OO FHIR COW/FOE minutes record both the preliminary SHALL text and the approved motion matching the Jira resolution. source/fhir.ini has an active task=Task entry, so source/task/task-introduction.xml is current build source. Local Zulip searches for FHIR-15561 and Task.focus instantiate terms found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/task/task-introduction.xml to the final approved sentence, limiting the guidance to entities represented by FHIR resources and using SHOULD rather than the broader SHALL rule.
source_changes: source/task/task-introduction.xml: replaced the preliminary SHALL/something sentence with the final approved SHOULD/FHIR-resource wording.
